card.name: Word starts like Open and cal
card.fires_on: The start of a longer word that has been split, mainly "cal" in calculated or calibrator, and "Open" before BSD or Office. It fires on the opening piece before the rest of the word follows.

modes.label: cal- word starts
modes.description: The piece "cal" begins words like calculated, calibrate or calibrator.

modes.label: Open before a software name
modes.description: The word Open begins a software or system name such as OpenBSD or OpenOffice.

card.plain: It fires on the first piece of a split word, such as cal in calculated, when more letters must follow.
